verdict.rationale: Bruno's CLI (bru-cli) explicitly supports running entire collections (not just single requests) from the command line, generating JSON/JUnit/HTML reports and integrating with CI/CD pipelines, which enables bulk execution of many API requests at once in an automatable, scriptable way (bruno-docs-28, bruno-docs-1, bruno-docs-3, bruno-docs-18). However, this is scoped to running/reporting on existing collections rather than broader bulk data operations (e.g., bulk edit/import/delete across many items), and there is no independent/hands-on evidence validating bulk-run reliability at scale. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk editing/transformation across many items (not just execution), independent corroboration of large-scale CLI runs, and any AI-specific batch/automation tooling beyond generic CI/CD use.
